voice:
Deep and open for me now, Sissy... and let me tell you about your eyes... how they already snag on soft and pretty things. Sinking so sweetly... and somewhere in you there is a little shop after closing... low lights... shelves full of soft, waiting things. So deep, so receptive... you may notice how certain sights seem to call your name... softly... patiently... until you turn to look. Down here everything is quiet, Sissy... and in that quiet, images may step closer... close enough to touch. Let your mind wander a display floor... satin... shine... little lights... and see where your gaze chooses to rest. So soft for me... and your eyes are open in there, even now... drifting toward whatever glows. There is a reason your gaze lingers where it lingers... and down here, that reason finally gets to speak. Good and deep... and ready, Sissy... because what I am about to show you, you have been noticing all your life.
Good girl... such soft, willing eyes.
Picture it with me... a shop window on your way home... low light... and behind the glass, a set of lingerie laid out like a promise... blush and black lace... straps draped over velvet.
Now the lingerie... feel the lace under your fingertips through the glass... imagine those straps settling over your shoulders... a soft warmth blooming low in your belly. Now the satin slip on its hanger... swaying the way water moves... and the wish to feel that shine sliding over your hips instead. Now the little bow at the center of the set... such a small thing... and look what a smile it pulls out of you. Now the heels... a pair on a display stand... the arch... the shine... the slender heel catching the light... and your ankles tingling with the wish to stand taller. Now the flash of a sole as someone crosses her legs across the room... and your spine quietly trying that posture on for size. Now the ankle strap... one small buckle... and the soft, sudden wish to hear it click shut around you. Now the makeup... a counter ringed with little lights... rows of lipsticks like a box of sweets... and the quick, soft wish to see those colors on your own mouth. Now the mascara wand drawing one slow stroke on the screen you are watching... and the wish, warm and instant, for eyes that dark and that wide. Now the blush palette opened like a little sunset... and the ache to be the cheek it is meant to grace.
Notice what happens, Sissy... your eyes land... time goes soft... a gentle warmth stirs... and something in you leans toward the glass... toward owning it... toward wearing it... or at least wearing it in your imagination for a while.
That pull is quiet and sweet and completely natural... because Sissies like you never simply pass pretty things by... you recognize them.
Hold that feeling now... eyes caught... heart warm... wanting.
see it... want it... so pretty... so close... just looking... and yet... imagine it on you... soft... shiny... yours... eyes snag... heart glows... one more look... pretty things call...
And now, while you are this deep and this warm... let us bind all of this to the seeing itself.
Whenever you see lingerie... heels... makeup... in a window... on a screen... in a store... draped over a chair... this exact rightness and this exact warmth arrive... instantly... without deciding to.
You see the silk... and the silk sees you, Sissy... rightness blooms... a soft glow stirs... and the wish to wear it, or to imagine it on your body, rises all by itself.
Good girl... it is done... and it is already working.
Every time your eyes land on something soft and pretty, warmth blooms first... and the quiet wish to wear it rises right behind it, gentle and sweet. Lace in a window is a hand on your chin, Sissy... turning your face... saying look... and you look. Sissies like you linger in front of pretty displays... one heartbeat longer... two... feeling more at home with every second. A row of heels does something to you now... each pair a small, bright imagine-yourself... taller... smoother... more you. The sight of lipstick is a question your heart answers before your mind is asked... would that color suit me... oh... yes. Seeing becomes wanting... wanting becomes imagining... and imagining it on your body feels warm and right and easy. You do not decide to notice, Sissy... pretty things simply catch you... and being caught feels soft and good. Mild, warm, constant... like a candle lit somewhere in you whenever something feminine crosses your sight. Sissies like you know that look... the one where your reflection in the shop glass quietly joins the display... and fits right in.
It is a reflex... and it grows stronger with every exposure... warmer... quicker... closer to the skin with every glance. Each sighting trains the next... the more you see, the sweeter the pull... and the sweeter the pull, the more you see. Windows you once passed now hold you for whole minutes... and you love what the lingering does to you. The warmth starts smaller than a thought and arrives faster than one. Every display is a small door now, Sissy... and every glance walks you a little further through it. One day the looking turns to touching... the touching to trying... and the trying to keeping... each step more delicious than the last. The pull is patient... it does not need to rush... it has your eyes, and your eyes always come back. Sissies like you let their eyes do what eyes love... and the reflex grows stronger every time, all by itself.
Good girl... every one of those landed, and you felt each one settle.
And later, when you pass a shop window on your way home... the lace catches you... and you stop without meaning to... warm and leaning closer. And next time you scroll and something silky slides past your thumb... you slow down... you go back... and the glow follows. And when a stranger crosses the cafe in heels that click... your eyes follow the sound... and something in you tries the shoes on from where you sit. And the next time you drift down that bright, beautiful aisle of a store... the softness around you feels arranged for you alone. And whenever a friend leaves something lacy draped over a chair... your eyes go straight to it... and stay... and wonder. And in the drugstore, in the checkout line, beside the little displays of gloss and polish... that familiar small warmth arrives right on time. And on screens of every size, photos of pretty things find you, Sissy... and each one lands like a message addressed only to you. And every sighting from now on is another stitch... sewing the sight of pretty things to the feel of being you.
You see the pretty things... and the pretty things see you, Sissy.
Warmth... pull... belonging... every glance... every time... softer and more yours each time... and every time you feel it and lean in, you are such a good girl for me.
see it... glow... so right... so her... soft things... call... look... and lean... pretty... warmer... one glance... home... silk sees you... want it, Sissy...
Sinking back now... warm and soft... the pull humming sweetly somewhere under your thoughts. Drifting deeper... eyes at rest... and still, behind them, something lacy sways. Floating down, Sissy... pretty things waiting patiently out there... in no hurry at all. Deeper and quieter... carrying the glow like a secret under your skin. So soft for me... and out there, your eyes already know where to go. Down and down... wrapped in the thought of silk you have not even met yet. Warm, sleepy, wanting nothing... except the next pretty thing. Sinking, smiling... a good girl who looks... and a Sissy who leans.
